_about: Synthetic posts for issue #4. Modeled on the kinds of post in the first live runs (2026-11-23): promos, a daily tool-update roundup, an explainer in someone else's thread, a competitor launch, a pricing essay, and direct questions and problem descriptions. All text, handles and ids are invented; no real X data. 'model' is what a research model would return in JSON mode; 'expect' is the outcome the rules must give.
product_brief:
# Product brief

Our product records what each coding agent did in one durable ledger.
Status is computed from the record, never estimated by an agent.
Teams use it to coordinate several coding agents working on the same repository.
Handoffs between agents keep their context because every step is written down.
